recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future change to the v2 landing page should be handled as a global mapping-space decision rather than a Patient-specific correction for FHIR-18326.
issue_request: FHIR-18326 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient mapping request to make the HL7 Version 2 mapping link on the Patient mappings page resolve to an appropriate HL7 page.
initial_application: The issue was applied by fc4ada0543, titled GF#18326 - fix mapping spaces links, which changed source/mappingSpaces.xml so the v2 mapping space renders a link to the HL7 v2 product brief instead of leaving the link empty.
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini and declares the v2 mapping identity in source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml. The current shared mapping-space source maps http://hl7.org/v2 to the HL7 v2 product brief and also adds a v2-FHIR Implementation Guide preamble link. The current build.fhir.org Patient mappings page renders those links. Negative Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant community evidence that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active build source already has the requested human-facing link, and the canonical v2 mapping URI should not be replaced because source/mappingSpaces.xml intentionally separates the mapping-space URL from the rendered link.
